data.reason_zh: 构建任务数据并用教师轨迹单次微调模型；探针修复只服务任务生成，无多轮自改进闭环。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family.
scope_support.feedback_quote: Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work.
scope_support.object_quote: We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks.
